basis: Defining myopathy, joint disease, skin damage and retinal degeneration; malabsorption described in the reported family; hypothyroidism omitted because of cap.
Intellectual disability defines disease; alopecia 80-99%, strabismus 11/29 (~38%). Skeletal dysmorphism lacks established functional damage; infections do not establish immunodeficiency.
Insulin deficiency or resistance defines this metabolic disorder; retinopathy, nephropathy and other organ complications are separately diagnosed diseases.
Cutaneous proliferation of hematopoietic mast cells causes infiltration, blistering and erosion; mediator-related gastrointestinal symptoms do not establish tissue damage.
Chronic immune-mediated, mast-cell-driven urticaria defines a skin disease; no additional organ damage established.
Nonsyndromic hearing loss, present in 3/3; PNPT1 alone does not justify additional systemic or metabolic labels.
Metopic craniosynostosis defines skeletal disease; global developmental delay reported in 1/3 (~33%) supports neurologic involvement.
Anterior horn motor-neuron disease; defining denervation amyotrophy causes persistent muscle loss in most patients; kyphoscoliosis also reported.
Brainstem/cerebellar malformation and thoracic skeletal dysplasia define disease; respiratory failure is defining. Functional renal disease and retinal dystrophy occur in 5-29%.
Fatty-acid oxidation defect; hypertrophic cardiomyopathy is an explicit parent. Episodic weakness and lethargy alone do not establish muscle or brain damage.
Cerebellar and peripheral axonal degeneration; persistent distal amyotrophy and pes cavus in 3/3. Mild hypercholesterolemia alone does not establish additional organ damage.
Bacillaceae bacterial infection umbrella; no single anatomical site is established across the group.
Defining microcephaly and corpus callosum dysgenesis affect the brain; cleft lip/palate affects oral structures.
Invasive fungal infection with variable anatomical sites; no supplied evidence establishes a particular organ as affected in at least 30%.
Corneal dystrophy directly causes recurrent corneal erosions and progressive visual loss.
Vertebral segmentation defects and rib fusion define skeletal disease; restrictive ventilatory impairment occurs in 44%.
Inflammation directly affects spinal nerve roots; generic inflammation or compression does not establish an autoimmune or immune-mediated mechanism.
Benign neoplasm originates in and occupies the middle ear.
Defined by disruption of valine metabolism; no specific additional organ damage established.
Autoinflammation with oral ulcers in 11/11; inflammatory arthritis in 5/11 (~45%). Uveitis 3/11 is below 30%; nonspecific rash does not establish lasting skin damage.
Treponemal infection with defining cutaneous and mucocutaneous lesions; no additional organ has established common direct injury at this stage.
Congenital atrial septal defect defines cardiac structural disease; reported rhythm abnormalities remain on the same axis.
Neurodegeneration with defining acanthocytosis; myopathy/muscle-fiber atrophy frequent (30-79%); repeated tongue/lip self-injury in 2/2 causes oral tissue damage.
Skin elastic-fiber damage and coagulation-factor deficiency; arterial disease frequent (30-79%), cerebral arterial dilation 1/2. Angioid streaks alone lack functional eye damage.
Chronic peripheral nerve disease explicitly attributed to metabolic dysfunction; no additional directly damaged organ specified.
